subject: Decision trajectory & enablement notes — NovaCorp pilot
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 May 2028 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Decision trajectory & enablement notes — NovaCorp pilot

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for a great discussion earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the buying path and who owns what internally.

Call recap (30 min):
- Pilot scope: evaluate Redwood inference for customer-facing chat & ticket summarization (production workload target: ~500k tokens/day after Q3).
- Key success criteria: latency under 350ms p95 on typical payloads, end-to-end cost below $X/token, and SOC2 alignment for data handling.
- Champions: Alex (product) is taking lead internally; recommended exec sponsor is CFO (we understand Rachel Lim will be the economic buyer).

Stakeholder map (initial):
- Economic/Finance: Rachel Lim (CFO) — will own budget decisions.
- Security/Legal: Michael O'Neil (security) — questionnaire and audit evidence gate.
- Procurement: Priya Singh (vendor ops) — contract and PO timing.
- Product/Champion: Alex Chen — day-to-day owner for technical validation and internal buy-in.

Immediate asks / owners:
1) Alex — can you confirm Rachel + Michael as the right contacts and share their timelines for review? Also confirm if Rachel prefers an ROI one-pager for the first pass.
2) Monica (CS) — I attached a one-pager ROI deck and a draft mutual action plan (MAP). Could you draft a short ROI slide (2 bullet points) tailored to NovaCorp's billing model?
3) Ben (AE) — I'll coordinate procurement cadence with you; please add any contract constraints early.

Attachments: NovaCorp-MAP.xlsx (draft MAP), Redwood-ROI-1pager.pdf (ROI starter).

Next meeting proposal: 30-min procurement + security kickoff w/ Rachel and Michael. Proposed times: Tue 5/16 10–11am PT or Wed 5/17 2–3pm PT. Let me know what works.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.ai

Thanks Mateo — really useful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Economic buyer: confirmed — Rachel Lim (rachel.lim@novacorp.com), expects a 1-page ROI-focused brief before any budget approvals.
2) Security: Michael O'Neil (michael.oneil@novacorp.com) will need our standard vendor questionnaire + SOC2. He's asked for the questionnaire by next Wednesday (5/16).
3) Procurement cadence: Priya will own the PO process; estimated internal procurement window ~3–4 weeks once security sign-off is complete.

We can take the ROI one-pager and MAP you attached and run them by Rachel. For the internal championing steps, I propose:
- Short internal demo (15 min) for finance + ops — Alex to present the business case, Mateo to cover technical fit.
- Security play: we can start with your SOC2/controls doc and a short controls mapping to our data classification.

I'll try to book the procurement + security kickoff for Tue 5/16 10am PT. If Rachel is unavailable that slot, Wed 5/17 2pm PT is my backup.

Alex

alex.chen@novacorp.com

2) Cost: "Pilot expected to run under $Y/day at projected volumes; Redwood Optimize suggestions should reduce long-term $/token by ~15%."

I'll stand by to help Alex prep the 15-minute internal demo.

Best — Mateo

- Timeline: if security signs off by 5/16 and procurement kicks off the week of 5/20, legal/contract could complete by mid-June. That aligns with a pilot start in late June.
